summary: Transient onboarding: merge contractor LDAP profile into full-time account and schedule device handback/repurpose
description:
Issue summary:
We have a contractor (email: aisha.oliver@redwood.ai) who is converting to a full-time engineer effective 2026-03-15. She currently has a contractor LDAP profile (contractor/aoliver) and a short-lived service account used for a shared GPU lab. HR requests a clean merge into the new full-time employee identity (employees/aoliver) rather than creating a brand new separate employee identity to preserve project history and reduce breakage in historical Git commits and CodeSearch links.

Background / why this is tricky:
- Contractor account was used to provision access to several Git repos (private infra repos), GCP service bindings, and a shared Dedicated cluster namespace.
- The contractor laptop (asset tag RWI-55431) was issued under the contractor profile and currently has disk encryption tied to the contractor's SSO MFA device and KMS key reference.
- Security wants to avoid key reuse across identities and prefers rekeying and reprovisioning for full-time hires. Hardware/Workplace Ops would like to reuse reimaged laptops for new hires when policy permits. HR prefers retaining commit history and internal ticket links under a single identity if possible.

Impact:
- Delaying access transition will block Aisha from completing her first-week tasks if full access is not granted by 2026-03-15.
- Aggressive merge without rekeying risks token/secret exposure between contractor-scoped resources and employee-scoped ones.

Requested outcome / acceptance criteria:
1) Contractor LDAP profile merged into employees/aoliver with preserved email alias and commit history updated (if needed) with minimal disruption to repo ACLs.
2) Asset RWI-55431 handback scheduled on 2026-03-16 for reprovisioning. Device must be reimaged and have disk encryption rekeyed to the new employee identity and KMS policy.
3) Update IAM bindings and service account ownership where contractor@example-service-account was used; introduce employee-scoped service accounts where appropriate and rotate keys.
4) Document the change in HR onboarding ticket and link to audit log entries.

Steps taken so far / preliminary investigation:
- HR (Jordan Kim) approved preserving commit history and requested the merge.
- SRE (initial investigator) listed affected repos via gitshortlog and found 8 private repos where contractor is the primary committer.
- Security (Priya Desai) flagged that the laptop encryption references contractor's MFA device; recommends rekeying rather than reusing disk keys.

Proposed plan (low-disruption):
A) Pre-merge tasks (by 2026-03-14):
   - Create employee identity employees/aoliver and add email alias aisha.oliver@redwood.ai. (Identity team)
   - Generate mapping plan for Git authorship preservation (git-filter-repo plan) with a read-only mirror to validate. (DevTools)
   - List service accounts and secrets tied to contractor profile. (Infra/SRE)
B) Cutover (scheduled for 2026-03-15 09:00 PT):
   - Freeze service account tokens tied to contractor profile and create employee equivalents.
   - Run Git author rewrite on mirrors; after validation, apply to primary repos during a low-traffic window.
   - Update repo ACLs to point to employees/aoliver.
C) Device handback (2026-03-16):
   - Aisha returns asset RWI-55431 to Workplace Ops. Device is wiped and reimaged using corporate image; disk encryption rekeyed to employees/aoliver KMS key.
   - MDM re-enroll with new SSO MFA binding and new device certs.
D) Post-cutover validation (by 2026-03-17):
   - Verify CI/CD pipelines and scheduled tasks still run and are not tied to the contractor's service account.
   - Confirm audit log entries for merges and key rotations are present.

Outstanding questions / policy decision required:
1) Is a full git history rewrite acceptable for these repos, or do we prefer to preserve history via commit-author mapping without rewriting history? (security / devtools tradeoff)
2) Can Workplace Ops reuse a reimaged device for other hires in the same region after rekeying, or does policy require Hardware Escrow for 6 months? (policy clarification requested from Security & Legal)
3) Are there any billing/entitlement implications when preserving an alias between contractor and employee identities?

Attachments / useful links:
- Slack thread: #hr-onboarding (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C02HRABC1/p167847...)
- Affected repos list: https://gist.github.com/aoliver/repo-list (internal)
- Runbook for Account Merges: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Onboarding+Account+Merge+Runbook
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Jordan Kim (HR): Confirmed hire start date 2026-03-15 and approval to preserve commit history where feasible.
2026-03-10 14:47 - Marcus Chen (Identity): Taking ownership of mapping plan. I'll produce a draft git-filter-repo plan and a non-destructive preview by EOD 2026-03-12.
2026-03-11 09:03 - Priya Desai (Security): Recommend rekeying device and rotating any long-lived service account keys. We'll need to schedule a secrets rotation window with SRE to avoid outages.

2026-03-11 16:30 - Marcus Chen: Inventory of tied service accounts complete. Found 3 service accounts with long-lived keys; will create equivalents under employees/aoliver and plan rotation for 2026-03-15 09:00 PT.
2026-03-12 11:00 - Lena Park: HR asks for policy clar on device reuse. Priya / Legal please advise whether rekey+reimage is sufficient or if hardware escrow is required.

2026-03-12 15:20 - Priya Desai (Security): Legal confirmed rekey+reimage is acceptable for standard hires; hardware escrow only required for decommissioned devices from high-sensitivity projects. Aisha was on a standard project, so rekey+reimage OK.
2026-03-12 17:05 - Marcus Chen: Updated plan, scheduling cutover for 2026-03-15 09:00 PT. Will post final checklist once git preview is validated.
2026-03-12 17:20 - Jordan Kim (HR): Noted. Aisha is OK with returning device on 2026-03-16 morning.
investigation_notes: Mapped 8 repos with primary commits from contractor account; 3 repos have signed commits tied to the contractor GPG key. Need to re-sign or append signed metadata post-merge.
Service account audit shows usage by CI job 'gpu-lab-runner' — scheduled rotation required and update to CI config to use new employee service account.
No active outstanding incidents found in past 90 days tied to contractor service accounts.
resolution_notes: (Pending) Plan approved by Security and HR; cutover scheduled 2026-03-15. Final confirmation to be posted after successful git preview and device handback. Will close ticket after post-cutover validation.
